title: FIPS gate missing: wolfssl/wolfssl_ec_key.c/key_export_public
description: wolfssl_ec_key.c:274 wolfssl_ec_key_export_public() has no fips_gate() call. The ECDSA ops table wires this function directly as .key_export_public (wolfssl_ecdsa_p256_ops and wolfssl_ecdsa_p384_ops). The ECDH ops table goes through a per-algo wrapper (wolfssl_ecdh_key_export_public) that does call the gate, but the shared function itself has no gate. Since ecdsa plugs this in directly without a wrapper, both ecdsa-p256 and ecdsa-p384 key_export_public invocations bypass the gate. This is a CMVP compliance failure.
